messages:
Ravi: Quick thread - customers want a single console view tying route-level cost + sampled traces. Proposal: 5-week MVP: heatmap, CSV export, tiny trace spans, and error buckets. Who can scope?
Sam: I'll own infra. Plan: rollups per-route+model per-minute and sampled spans. Default sample 0.5%. If ingest rises, fall back to aggregates.
Elena: UX: heatmap with model rows and routes columns; color = $/1k tokens. Click cell -> show top error classes + sample traces. Add quick "recommendation" showing estimated $ delta for model switch.
Priya: CS: enterprise customers require S3 export and PII masking rules. Default: scrub prompt/user IDs. Enterprise can opt-in for richer spans behind KMS. Also need CSV with "impact" column.
Ravi: Draft launch criteria: heatmap + CSV export, sampling toggle in org settings, p95 latency regression <2% in canary, ingest overhead <5% or fallback to aggregates, default PII scrubbing.
Sam: Rollout: canary 10% non-enterprise for 10 days, watch p95, error rate, and ingest_delta_by_org. If green -> 50% for 7 days -> full. RolloutBot: canary started at 6200001240 :rocket:
Elena: I'll mock UI by Friday. Sam + Priya to provide infra/cost estimate and customer masking needs by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi: Thanks team. Follow-up in #product next Wednesday.
